audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer gave Lissandra all seven rows; the content win[] and the packet levelChart both give levels 1 through 5 to Skill.
audit.why: Pre-6 Katarina pays no mana for anything: Bouncing Blade is free at 625, Shunpo is free at 725 on 12-to-8s. She is not losing those rows, she just cannot kill you either. The flip is Frozen Tomb at 6, which cancels a 75/60/45s Death Lotus channel.
audit.corrected: Full sides realigned to Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Lissandra, Lissandra, Lissandra with each early why rewritten to argue an even lane instead of a won one.

audit.why: Level 6 (Frozen Tomb vs Death Lotus), first item, and late reset-snowballing are the real spikes and the content spikes[] already name them.
audit.corrected: Left as-is apart from the fabricated ability name in spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things: 'Death Lily' is not an ability — her R is Death Lotus — and nothing on the page said Death Lotus applies Grievous Wounds to the Frozen Tomb heal you are counting on.
audit.why: packet.defects and suspectNames flag the name; the kit gives Katarina's R the antiHeal flag and Riot's text confirms the channel. Your R's heal is the sustain that anti-heal blunts, which is exactly what missingInteractions raises.
audit.corrected: Name corrected in spikes[1].text and mid; breakdown.mid now carries the Grievous Wounds timing; breakdown.cooldowns carries Shunpo 12-to-8s, Bouncing Blade 11-to-7s, Death Lotus 75/60/45s and Voracity's cooldown refund on a kill.
